rules.workflowRole: Reusable workflows own the consumer API and job authority boundaries.
rules.compositeRole: Composite actions compose external and internal uses only.
rules.javascriptRole: JavaScript actions adapt declared inputs to named domain APIs; modules own business orchestration.
rules.reuseBoundary: Share actions for coherent cross-workflow capabilities; share ordinary functions through core modules.
rules.distribution: Every JavaScript main and post entry is bundled; contract and WASM assets remain in the verified runtime closure.

adopter.responsibility: Admit, qualify and reconcile downstream adopter contracts.

artifact.responsibility: Package, transfer, attest and finalize build artifacts.

attestation.responsibility: Prepare and verify provider-backed build attestations against exact artifact bytes.

binary.responsibility: Build standalone distributions and bind publication evidence.

credential.responsibility: Own temporary credentials and their cleanup lifecycle.

demo.responsibility: Execute and qualify auditable demo adapters and media.

environment.responsibility: Provision the declared build environment before consumer lifecycle execution.

gate.responsibility: Plan, execute and aggregate declared build gates.

lifecycle.responsibility: Validate configuration and execute declared consumer lifecycle stages.

plan.responsibility: Compile source configuration and runner policy into the immutable build plan.

signing.responsibility: Admit signing requests, execute platform signing transactions and verify complete result delivery.

source.responsibility: Admit source identity and qualify source verification evidence.

stage-capsule.responsibility: Qualify and reconcile portable stage checkpoint reuse.

verification.responsibility: Verify the repository and reusable build backbone.

candidate.responsibility: Admit, reserve and qualify immutable delivery candidates.

native.responsibility: Dispatch, execute, heartbeat and seal native execution without merging its authority jobs.

queue.responsibility: Land qualified deliveries and reconcile protected queue state.

warrant.responsibility: Settle or cancel delivery warrants with terminal evidence.

alpha-candidate.responsibility: Observe and settle alpha candidate governance without publishing.

candidate.responsibility: Render source-owned candidate review material with isolated consumer credentials.

dev-qualification.responsibility: Observe and apply protected dev qualification decisions.

housekeeping.responsibility: Plan repository maintenance and apply scoped labels or branch cleanup.

controller.responsibility: Bind controller plans and seal observed stage/evidence receipts across workflow domains.

evidence.responsibility: Admit and publish governed observed evidence.

candidate.responsibility: Admit and publish governed paper candidates.

aws.responsibility: Acquire declared AWS role credentials within the caller OIDC permission boundary.

github.responsibility: Manage scoped GitHub credentials and provider integrations.

source.responsibility: Acquire exact source bytes and preserve provider checkout evidence.

authority.responsibility: Assemble and verify publication authority from candidate and artifact evidence.

binary.responsibility: Validate and publish immutable standalone binary assets with provider readback.

candidate.responsibility: Plan, build and collect publication candidates.

settlement.responsibility: Retain immutable publication completion and verify its terminal receipt independently.

transaction.responsibility: Initialize release intent, append independently owned progress and inspect one durable Discussion across workflow recovery.

binary.responsibility: Resolve coordinates and publish admitted binary assets.

line.responsibility: Open a release line and verify its lineage.

promotion.responsibility: Resolve, qualify, apply and settle release promotion transactions.

propagation.responsibility: Plan, materialize and deliver release propagation.

reseal.responsibility: Plan, qualify and seal release-tail restoration.

signing.responsibility: Admit signing requests, isolate platform credentials and deliver verified signatures.

tail.responsibility: Settle release-tail publication and terminal evidence.

dependencies.responsibility: Install exact lockfile dependencies under declared script and production policies.

environment.responsibility: Compose the selected Node environment and locked dependency preparation.

selection.responsibility: Select the execution runtime once at the public entry; authorize transient recovery before preparation.

toolchain.responsibility: Expose and validate declared runner-local toolchains for subsequent actions.

controller.responsibility: Plan and receipt the web controller evidence lifecycle.

deployment.responsibility: Execute verified channel deployment transactions and preserve their observations.

feedback.responsibility: Report observed deployment and release outcomes to reviewers.

planning.responsibility: Admit inputs, resolve release intent and plan web deployment.

preview.responsibility: Deploy or clean up isolated web previews.

production.responsibility: Open governed release PRs and deploy admitted production releases.

publication.responsibility: Admit and decide production publication authority.

staging.responsibility: Deploy staging and return release feedback.

admission.responsibility: Reject requests that fail workflow admission.

bootstrap.responsibility: Admit, execute and settle workflow bootstrap.

dogfood.responsibility: Prepare and reconcile public-contract dogfood execution.

engine.responsibility: Execute independently admitted candidate capabilities and retain rooted terminal results.

event.responsibility: Admit supported caller events before source-controlled work begins.

settlement.responsibility: Seal candidate terminal evidence and reconcile successful protected backflow.

policy.responsibility: Admit consumer source and workflow definitions against the selected runtime contract locks.
